text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly—even a thirty-minute walk every day makes a big difference. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, because good rest helps your body recover and improves your mood. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Don't spend all your time working; enjoy hobbies and time with family and friends. Small daily habits lead to a healthier, happier life.
